snippet.title: Dungoku - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Outsmart the undead, explore the dungeons and loot your way down an ancient spire in this retro-inspired dark fantasy puzzler - Dungoku!

Coming to PC in 2026. Wishlist on Steam 👇
